m.x: Cubic ease-in/out. Produces an S-curve that accelerates from zero, reaches maximum speed at the midpoint, then decelerates back to zero. The acceleration and deceleration both follow a cubic (t³) curve, giving a stronger ease than the quadratic equivalent. Typically used to animate values that should start and end smoothly while moving briskly through the middle of the transition.

p.x: The value to be eased, in the range [0, 1].

r.x: The eased value, in the range [0, 1].
